title: Hareta Hi no Dress Code
titleNative: 晴れた日のドレスコード
synopsis: If only I could wear my favorite clothes however I want— Natsuki Yonei, a first-year high school girl, thought about wearing slacks to school, but she ended up going with the "safe" option of a skirt instead. But there is one girl, Miwa Omi, who is wearing pants, even though all the other girls are wearing skirts. Intrigued, Natsuki tries to befriend her, and she learns the reason why Miwa doesn't wear skirts... A first-love in uniform, a sparkling yet slightly bittersweet chapter of high school life. (Source: Yuri Hime, translated)

title: Kocchi Mite yo, Sensei
synopsis: Ui fell head over heels for art teacher Yugahara at his high school orientation. No matter how many times he proclaims his love, Yugahara keeps finding reasons to turn him down, saying that they're both guys and that they’re teacher and student. “I graduate in six months, so please wait for me until then.” Determined to make his teacher look his way, Ui keeps up with his relentless pursuit today and every day! An absolute 120% pure high school romance that will have you rooting for the lovestruck boy! (Source: Futabasha, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: Arpeggio of Blue Steel
synonyms: สงครามเรือรบสยบโลก
synopsis: In the early 21st century, the majority of Earth’s landmass is submerged due to rising sea levels. Enter the Fleet of Fog, a host of sentient alien battleships of unknown origin who easily decimate earth’s naval forces. Humanity is now on the verge of extinction. In the year 2056, the stalwart Captain Chihaya Gunzou and his intrepid crew on the Blue Steel fleet may be humanity’s last chance to fight off the alien invaders. The Blue Steel fleet happens to contain a secret weapon that could turn the tide of war: a mysterious I-401 submarine that can transform into a girl. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Notes: Nominated to the 22nd Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

title: Animagami
synopsis: Ichirou is a young boy who has been protecting his younger brother, Jirou, from the Drax—creatures that threaten humanity. One day, after being attacked by a Drax and pushed into a desperate, helpless crisis, the Teras Foundation appears before him—an organization that connects humanity and fights back against the Drax. The foundation utilizes the power of the wolf monster—Lycan. Witnessing this overwhelming power, Ichirou throws himself into battle in order to protect his brother…

synopsis: Nozomi Kashihara's parents were killed when he was young, and he has lived a life as an assassin without knowing any human warmth. Betraying the "family" that raised him, he now spends his days as a serious high school student without any friends. But when he helped Shingu-san, a gal in his class, from some delinquents, they begin to form a relationship. But Kashihara can't help but suspect that she might be an assassin targeting him...? title: You Shou Yan
synopsis: In the wake of scientific advancement, the once majestic mythological animals can't be compared to the olden days now. The mythological animal Sibuxiang received orders to descend to the mortal world and to help out other mythological animals in dire straits wandering the human world. In the secular world, he met his old colleague Pixiu in a tight spot, his drinking buddy Tuye down in his luck, and the gold and silver Jue brothers who were demoted to the mortal world... what kind of stories will happen between them? (Source: AC.QQ, translated)
